sourceContext.title: Sourcecontext
sourceContext.description: JSON-encoded object matching the SourceContext schema (pass as a JSON string, not a nested object). Required key 'source': the source resource name, format 'sources/{source}' (get valid values from list_sources, e.g. 'sources/github/{owner}/{repo}'). Optional key 'githubRepoContext': object with required 'startingBranch' (the branch to start the session from). Example value for this field: {"source": "sources/github/octocat/hello-world", "githubRepoContext": {"startingBranch": "main"}}

requirePlanApproval.description: If true, plans require explicit approval before execution. If not set, plans are auto-approved.
requirePlanApproval.title: Requireplanapproval

automationMode.title: Automationmode
automationMode.description: Enum for session automation settings. Allowed values: 'AUTOMATION_MODE_UNSPECIFIED' (no automation, default), 'AUTO_CREATE_PR' (automatically create a pull request when the session completes).
